column1: # name|ctx|mtp|kv_quant|max_tokens|need_mib|basis|summary
# NOTHING IN THIS FILE WAS MEASURED. need_mib is ESTIMATED from the pack's file
# sizes and config.json at revision 7eaef0fa (arithmetic in README.md), with
# vision off (the launcher's default):
#   weights   100 shards, 74,405,350,320 B               70,958 MiB
#   KV        12 full-attention layers x 2 KV heads x 256 dims x bf16 x K+V
#             = 24,576 B/token, + MTP head 2,048 + sparse-attention indexer
#   GDN       36 linear-attention layers, fixed f32 state   108 MiB
#   prefix    mlx-serve's default --prefix-cache-mem cap  2,048 MiB
# NOT included: the prefill working set (unmeasured; the launcher demands
# MLXSERVE_PREFLIGHT_HEADROOM_MIB on top), and the 29.8 GiB n-gram table, which
# mlx-serve mmaps and never makes resident (the pack's card: "its cost is page
# cache, which the OS evicts as needed").
# For comparison: the MTPLX pack of this model was MEASURED at 77.3 GB wired,
# and a session there reached a 97 GiB peak at ~115k context. An estimate of
# weights + KV would have said ~75 GiB for that too, so treat these rows as a
# floor, not a ceiling.
